Go Condition: Backend CI and frontend CI and smoke checks are green
No-Go Condition: Any required CI or smoke check is failed or unresolved

Go Condition: User Acceptance Test completed with sign-off and accepted limitations
JWT Secret and CORS and authentication fallback and data handling are reviewed
No-Go Condition: Secret handling or security configuration is unsafe or unreviewed

Go Condition: Backup and restore procedure and verification evidence are complete
No-Go Condition: Backup missing or restore path unclear or verification not completed

Go Condition: Pilot users and admin access and Authority Level memberships and unauthorized checks are confirmed
No-Go Condition: User access is incomplete or excessive or not reviewed

Go Condition: Risk matrix and committees and Board of Origin and approvals and Audit integrity expectations are reviewed
No-Go Condition: SMS governance process is unclear or unapproved

Go Condition: Production logging and Request ID and health and readiness endpoints are verified
No-Go Condition: Diagnostics missing or unsafe or unreviewed

Go Condition: Critical defects closed and major defects dispositioned
No-Go Condition: Open critical defects or unaccepted major defects remain

Go Condition: Support owner and escalation path are assigned for pilot period
No-Go Condition: No support owner or escalation path is available
